_notes.book_value: ESTIMATE, Sep-30-2026 post-merger: Jun-30 equity NT$281740m (reported BVPS 17.40, MoneyDJ) + 3Q26 net income NT$10420m (9M 31,850 - 1H 21,430, company monthly releases) + fair value of shares issued NT$60758m (1,531.5m x NT$39.67, the Aug-2026 P/B 2.28 x 17.40 per HiStock). _notes.cost_of_equity: 6.06% = TWD riskless 1.51% (Taiwan 10Y 1.99% on 2026-10-30 less Taiwan default spread 0.477%, Damodaran Jul-2026) + bottom-up beta 1.0 x ERP 4.55% (Damodaran implied US ERP 4.20% on 2026-10-01 vs a 5.29% T-bond, held at the 10-30 yield). Local regression beta 0.12 (MoneyDJ, vs TAIEX) rejected: TSMC is ~42% of TAIEX. Taiwan event risk sits in the hazard overlay, not in the discount rate.
_notes.hazard: 1.5%/yr, 90% loss of equity (a bank's book is a claim on the same economy); applied to every dividend (DDM form)
_notes.roll_forward: 12-month TP = fair value x (1 + cost of equity) - NT$1.7 dividend (estimate: 2026E EPS ~2.56 x 65% payout; paid ~Jul-2027)
_notes.roe_history: ROE 2021 10.96%, 1H22 7.52%, 2024 10.66%, 2025 13.04%, 1Q26 14.43%, 1H26 15.46% (company releases); 1H26 net fee income +39.9%, wealth-management fees +30.7%
_notes.dupont: ROE = ROA x leverage. Leverage 17.0x = 1H26 ROE 15.46% / ROA 0.91% (company); 2021 16.6x, 2024 15.7x, 2025 16.3x. ROA 2021 0.66%, 2024 0.68%, 2025 0.80%, 1H26 0.91%. Post-merger leverage not disclosed until the 3Q26 statements.
_notes.scenarios: Base ROE 13.5% (2027) -> 12.5% -> 12% steady: fee income normalises from a bull-market peak (1H26 net fees +39.9%) but stays above 2021-24 (~10.7%) with Mercuries Life and the wealth franchise. Bull holds 14-15% (fees structurally higher, bancassurance synergies). Bear: market correction in 2028 (ROE 8.5%; 1H22 was 7.52%), then 10.5% (2021-24 level).
